title: bt-dht: improve whitespace consistency
description:
Cleans up some of the whitespace inconsistencies in the bt-dht dissector.
* `if(` -> `if (` and similar
* `func(a,b)` -> `func(a, b)`
* `a==b` -> `a == b` and other operators

In the cases that were easy to grep for this also matches the dominant style across the whole codebase.

commits_data.title: bt-dht: consistent whitespace around operators
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: consistent whitespace around operators

Add whitespace around various operators to make the file more internally
consistent.

a==b -> a == b
a!=b -> a != b
a+=b -> a += b
a-=b -> a -= b
a>=b -> a >= b
a+b -> a + b
a-b -> a - b
a>b -> a > b

commits_data.message:
bt-dht: add whitespace around commas in lists

Add whitespace after commas in function call argument lists for make the
file more consistent internally and with the rest of Wireshark. Also
removes one case of whitespace before the comma.
